summary: Change run_all so the delay_seconds sleep happens only between jobs, not after the last one, so batches finish without wasted waiting.
narrative: The owner asked for a small fix: run_all(delay_seconds=...) was also sleeping after the final job. Memory holds one observation (#1) noting that run_all sleeps after every job, including the last. It records no code change, PR, or confirmation yet, so the work is at the investigation stage.
